# Instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure

1. Start with the accounting records.
2.
completion:
Enter total gross sales revenue in the first line item of the loss schedule.
3. Add back expenses which have nothing to do with the company's bottom-line performance (e.g., loan fees, legal fees, etc.)
4. Carefully read [the definitions of what "loss of revenue" means](https://www.sba.gov/funding-programs/loans/covid-19-relief-options/paycheck-protection-program#section-header-4 "The definitions of what loss of revenue means" ).

  > If the borrower elects to use the eight-week covered period, from February 15, 2020 through June 30, 2020, the borrower must document the reduction in revenue sustained during the covered period compared to any of the following: 

  1.  Total gross receipts for a quarter of the borrower during 2019
